SELECT a1.code_module
FROM assessments a1
JOIN studentAssessment sa1 ON a1.id_assessment = sa1.id_assessment
WHERE a1.assessment_type = 'CMA' AND sa1.score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a1.code_module
HAVING AVG(sa1.score) > (
    SELECT AVG(sa2.score)
    FROM assessments a2
    JOIN studentAssessment sa2 ON a2.id_assessment = sa2.id_assessment
    WHERE a2.assessment_type = 'TMA' AND sa2.score IS NOT NULL AND a2.code_module = a1.code_module
)
